schema.name: MLCN Compact Attack Traffic Profiles
schema.purpose: Compact empirical specification for designing controlled traffic experiments.

DDoS.profile_purpose: Empirical feature-space target profile derived from the CICIDS-based dataset.

top_discriminative_features.traffic_characteristic: average packet throughput over the flow
average time between consecutive flow packets
number of packets transmitted in forward direction
average packet size across the flow

Brute Force.profile_purpose: Empirical feature-space target profile derived from the CICIDS-based dataset.

top_discriminative_features.traffic_characteristic: number of packets returned in reverse direction
number of packets transmitted in forward direction
average packet throughput over the flow
average byte throughput over the flow
top_discriminative_features.controllable_dimensions: data volume; flow duration; transmission rate

important_note: The values in this file are empirical target characteristics derived from the dataset. They are not manually constructed 24-feature vectors. Traffic parameters must be experimentally validated by generating real traffic and allowing M1-M4 to recalculate the resulting features.
